leave_one_trait_out.rule: Refit the identical intercept-only crossed REML model after dropping all systems for each admitted trait in turn, provided the remaining graph still has >=2 trait levels and >=2 family levels.
leave_one_trait_out.role: descriptive robustness only; cannot replace primary full-core architecture

leave_one_family_out.rule: Refit the identical model after dropping all systems for each admitted family in turn, provided >=2 family levels and >=2 trait levels remain.
